Specification: This specification models Google's Percolator-style distributed transaction protocol with primary and secondary keys, timestamp assignment, prewrite locking, primary-key commit, stale-lock cleanup, and client aborts. It tracks clients, per-key data versions, locks, committed writes, and auxiliary variables used to check a snapshot isolation condition by comparing commit timestamps against the last observed read timestamp. The spec verifies safety properties including type correctness, write ordering and non-overlap, lock consistency, consistency of committed and aborted transactions, and preservation of snapshot isolation, expressed by a theorem that PercolatorSpec implies these invariants always hold.
IfThenElse: IF key_last_read_ts[k] >= commit_ts THEN key_si' = [key_si EXCEPT ![k] = FALSE] ELSE UNCHANGED <<key_si>>

IF writes = {} THEN IF hasLockEQ(l.primary, l.ts) THEN /\ key_data' = [key_data EXCEPT ![l.primary] = @ \ {[ts |-> l.ts]}] /\ key_lock' = [key_lock EXCEPT ![l.primary] = @ \ {l}] /\ UNCHANGED <<key_write, key_si>> ELSE /\ key_data' = [key_data EXCEPT ![k] = @ \ {[ts |-> l.ts]}] /\ key_lock' = [key_lock EXCEPT ![k] = @ \ {l}] /\ UNCHANGED <<key_write, key_si>> ELSE \E w \in writes : /\ key_lock' = [key_lock EXCEPT ![k] = @ \ {l}] /\ key_write' = [key_write EXCEPT ![k] = Append(@, w)] /\ checkSnapshotIsolation(k, w.ts) /\ UNCHANGED <<key_data>>

IF hasLockEQ(l.primary, l.ts) THEN /\ key_data' = [key_data EXCEPT ![l.primary] = @ \ {[ts |-> l.ts]}] /\ key_lock' = [key_lock EXCEPT ![l.primary] = @ \ {l}] /\ UNCHANGED <<key_write, key_si>> ELSE /\ key_data' = [key_data EXCEPT ![k] = @ \ {[ts |-> l.ts]}] /\ key_lock' = [key_lock EXCEPT ![k] = @ \ {l}] /\ UNCHANGED <<key_write, key_si>>

IF primary \in pending THEN /\ canLockKey(primary, start_ts) /\ lockKey(primary, start_ts, primary) /\ client_key' = [client_key EXCEPT ![c].pending = @ \ {primary}] /\ UNCHANGED <<client_state, client_ts>> ELSE \E k \in pending : /\ canLockKey(k, start_ts) /\ lockKey(k, start_ts, primary) /\ client_key' = [client_key EXCEPT ![c].pending = @ \ {k}] /\ UNCHANGED <<client_state, client_ts>>

IF client_key[c].pending = {} THEN /\ next_ts' = next_ts + 1 /\ client_state' = [client_state EXCEPT ![c] = "committing"] /\ client_ts' = [client_ts EXCEPT ![c].commit_ts = next_ts'] /\ UNCHANGED <<key_vars, client_key>> ELSE /\ lock(c) /\ UNCHANGED <<next_ts>>
